rationale: CRSP has already fallen sharply today (gapping down ~2% and then selling off to near the session low, now at 0.9% of range), with price sitting just 0.09% above the day's low and well below VWAP ($46.38) and the 9-EMA ($45.29). The stock is in a clear downtrend on elevated volume (3.38x relative), but with only 54 minutes to close and the position already at the extreme low of the range, the risk/reward for a short is poor (minimal room before forced liquidation compresses any move), while a long counter-trend entry against a strong downtrend with no news catalyst and a weak broad market is equally unattractive. The account is already down on the day and the mechanical setup lacks a clear edge in either direction at this late stage.
